map.由实际利率与通胀求名义利率 使用指南: Find nominal rate from real rate and inflation - user guide
map.费雪方程计算器，输入实际利率 r 与通胀率 π 按 i≈r+π 求名义利率，用于: The Fisher equation calculator enters real rate r and inflation pi and finds nominal rate by i approx r + pi, for interest-rate and inflation analysis.
map.输入实际利率 r 与通胀率 π，求名义利率。: Enter real rate r and inflation pi to find the nominal rate.
map.名义利率：录入实际利率与预期通胀，算名义利率。: Nominal rate: enter real rate and expected inflation to compute nominal rate.
map.实际利率：由名义利率减通胀得实际利率（近似）。: Real rate: nominal minus inflation gives real rate (approximate).
map.教学演示：演示通胀预期上升推高名义利率。: Teaching demo: shows how rising inflation expectations push up the nominal interest rate.
map.：示例：实际利率 2%、通胀 3%，名义利率≈5%。: : example: real rate 2%, inflation 3%, nominal rate approx 5%.
map.近似式 i≈r+π；精确为 (1+i)=(1+r)(1+π)，低通胀下差异小。结: Approximation i approx r + pi; exact is (1+i)=(1+r)(1+pi), with small difference at low inflation. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, not investment advice or policy basis; for forecasts and empirical estimates, defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.费雪用预期通胀；事后可用实际通胀反推已实现实际利率。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算: Fisher uses expected inflation; ex post, actual inflation can back out the realized real rate. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, not investment advice or policy basis; for forecasts and empirical estimates, defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.名义利率低于通胀即实际为负，鼓励借入、抑制储蓄。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参考: Nominal rate below inflation means real is negative, encouraging borrowing and discouraging saving. Results are only for economics teaching and quick estimation reference, not investment advice or policy basis; parts involving prediction and empirical estimation defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
